## Findings from section-01.txt
1. The survey analyzes over 1400 research papers.
2. LongRoPE achieves a 2048K token context window through two stages: fine-tuning models to 256K length, then applying positional interpolation.
3. GPT-4 achieves approximately 20% absolute performance improvement through the Self-Refine method.
4. Nothing relevant in this section.
5. The four categories of System Implementations are Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Memory Systems, Tool-Integrated Reasoning, and Multi-Agent Systems.
